answer: Agents must post a recursive STARK proof binding each identity to a unique stake commitment, refreshed per epoch from a shared randomness beacon so that cloned keys cannot replicate the folding history. This proof is gossiped as a signed echo through the off-chain arbitration layer, letting peers reject duplicate commitments before the next tide of epoch admissions. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
